title: SG-1.2.2 · Create the typed UI store in game/frontend/src/store
summary: Zustand UI store with drawer, modal, sound and settings state, actions and a typed useUiStore hook
description: Context: game/frontend has zustand declared in package.json but no src/store directory exists. Desired behavior: src/store/uiStore.ts exports a Zustand store holding drawer open state, modal state, sound-enabled and settings flags, with toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings actions, exposed through a typed useUiStore hook. Expected result: components can import useUiStore, and unit tests exercise the real store module. Why: the shell, header and contribution modal need shared UI state.
acceptance_criteria: Given the module src/store/uiStore.ts, when imported, then it exports a typed useUiStore hook
Given the store, when each of toggleDrawer, openModal, closeModal, toggleSound and toggleSettings is called, then the matching state changes
Given the unit tests, when they run, then they import the real store and mock nothing from it
definition_of_done: Store and tests are committed together
